_comment: The simulated KCU1500 of the timing BEB (drp -D tb) for psdaq.sim.rogue_dev: psdaq/configdb/tb_config.py first reads the card's firmware image name through its own _DevRoot, then builds lcls2_pgp_pcie_apps.DevRoot for that image on the same PCIe map. Keys are pyrogue register paths; values are what the hardware reports.

_DevRoot.DevPcie.AxiVersion.BuildStamp.string: Lcls2XilinxKcu1500Pgp4_6Gbps: Vivado v2023.1, rdsrv (Ubuntu 20.04), Built Mon Jan  1 00:00:00 PST 2024 by sim

_BuildStamp: AxiVersion.ImageName is parsed from it ('<image>: <env>, <server>, Built <date> by <builder>'); tb_init takes an image starting with Lcls2Xilinx to lcls2_pgp_pcie_apps.DevRoot
_Locked: what the timing receiver reports once its clocks and link are up: ConfigLclsTimingV2's LockProc waits for MmcmLocked == 3 and RxLinkUp == 1
_RxId: the XPM's remote link id; the DRP takes the link id simxpm assigns, not this one
